A '''ration pack''' was a compact meal designed to provide basic sustenance. It was often used by ground forces, usually [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]]. It included sweet energy cubes. Six of them could fit into a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] pouch.<ref name="SWRGSECR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> It would provide one day's nourishment.
